result:
Round 508 is accepted and round 509 is planned: **CONTINUE**. I changed no app code, and the store worktree is still clean at `cf89736`.

**Round 508:** C passed every row (C0–C12) with real browser checks and found 0 bugs. The gate published `cf89736` on both remotes, so that is round 509's baseline.
- The audio-player stage of the button cleanup (NONBRAND N1) is verified, and A-R507-CR-1, CR-2 and CR-4 are closed.
- A asked whether its icon-threshold mutant (X1) falls under an existing pre-ruled item. I ruled yes, and recorded it as a deferred Low.
- A's other new Lows and the gate reviewer's Lows are recorded and deferred.
- C's two observations are filed. The 1 px focus ring is added to an existing finding. The teal on the home hero comes from the hero image/video, not from CSS, so it is recorded as information only.
- The previous task is copied to `tasks/round-508.md`, and before-copies of the backlog, status board and `b-next.json` are in `b-round-508/`.

**Round 509 fixes the product-page "Complimentary Download" button (Medium), which does nothing when clicked.**
- **Reproduced in the browser.** The mock API has no free product, so I made the free price in the page data request that loads on in-app navigation, which works in the cloud. Clicking the button changes nothing: no dialog, no navigation, no errors. The mock-API free fixture we asked root for is therefore no longer needed.
- **Target, from product-designer:**
  - The button becomes "Get it free" and runs the same handler as Buy Now. A moves that handler unchanged into a new `app/hooks/useBuyNowAction.ts`, which the purchase header also uses.
  - It shows only when the selected version costs $0, is sellable and is not owned. This also fixes a second defect: the sidebar decided "free" from the Standard price even when Premium was selected and priced.
  - It moves onto the shared Button component (primary, large, full width), which completes that button's cleanup migration in the same change.
- **Scope:** A may change 7 files. Protected files, `CartContext.tsx` and `/free-downloads` are untouched, and no new download path is created.
- **Tests:** a new test file (rows SF1–SF9) and the existing PU7 test rewritten to the new label. Ten mutants each name the row they must break.
- **Collision check:** I ran the full suite with the change applied on a scratch copy outside `store/`. Only PU7 fails, and it is in the task.
- **C checks:** in the browser at 1440, 1280 and 375:
  - anonymous click and keyboard;
  - switching versions;
  - a paid product without stubs;
  - signed-in click and owned product, using the round-504 sign-in stubs;
  - a store-to-sign-in journey;
  - grep, protection and claims rows.
- **One row is BLOCKED:** the real $0 order needs the backend, which the cloud doesn't have. I opened FREE-CHECKOUT-REAL-BACKEND (Medium) for it; it does not block the loop.

**New pre-existing finding (Medium):** the sign-in pop-up has no dialog role and never moves focus into itself. Keyboard focus stays on the button behind it. I added it to the planned shared-dialog task, which is waiting on root. It doesn't block round 509.

**Questions for Saba** (`user-review/questions-round-509.md`). Each default ships until he answers:
- **Q1, how free products are delivered.** Default: a $0 order through the normal checkout after sign-in. Stripe may refuse a $0 order; that needs the backend to confirm.
- **Q2, the header "Buy Now" label on $0 products.** Default: unchanged this round.
- **Q3, "Get it free" vs the store's word "Complimentary".** Default: "Get it free" on the button only.

**Timing:** RETRO is round 510. The regression round is due from 2026-11-16, so not yet. No architecture checkpoint is needed: one small hook and no new state.

**Advisor and agents:** I used the advisor twice, before planning and as a closing check, and applied its fixes. I consulted product-designer once.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- b-round-508.md
- b-next.json
- feature-status.md
